previous.reason: Development revision after inspecting the first context result (two white attempts around22s): require shooting motion, keeper interception and either goalward path fragments OR a keeper-origin rebound. A defensive-zone restart alone is insufficient. The earlier arbitrary two-corroborator rule suppressed saves when play continued without a stoppage. High confidence, clear attempt, on-target yes, contextual basis and no alternative explanation are still required. This revision is not a fresh independent evaluation.
